events.summary: Baseline review of the Wikimedia Liner Notes reference: exact package bytes, context descriptor, Wikidata/Wikipedia hosts, short-summary source policy, synthetic fixture, attribution/licence provenance and tests were checked for 0.1.0.
limitations: v0.1 uses the English Wikipedia sitelink only and may return no card when an artist has no suitable linked page.
Wikipedia summaries can change and can reflect the limitations of the underlying article; Melodex preserves source attribution rather than treating the text as authoritative editorial copy.
Runtime process isolation is not a complete operating-system sandbox.
